'''Balisk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and a member of the [[Knights of Zakuul]]. He and his husband lived on [[Zakuul]], and in [[3631 BBY]] he was assigned as the replacement partner for the Knight [[Novo]], whose previous partner [[Tanek]] had died during the pursuit of [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]]. Novo was determined to hunt down the Outlander for Tanek's death, and so the pair tracked down the Outlander at the [[Razor (Zakuul)|Razor]] in [[District 1327|Breaktown]] and tried to arrest the fugitive, only to be defeated.

==Behind the scenes==
Balisk appears at the Razor encounter regardless of player choices. The Outlander can kill Novo and Balisk for dark side points or spare them for light side points. If spared, Balisk will send an encrypted e-mail to the Outlander, thanking him for sparing him and letting him return to his husband.
